def _scheduled_event_export(event, user, next_run):
    return ScheduledEventExport.objects.create(
        event=event,
        owner=user,
        export_identifier='orderlist',
        export_form_data={},
        locale='en',
        mail_subject='Export',
        mail_template='Here is your export.',
        schedule_rrule='FREQ=DAILY',
        schedule_rrule_time=time(6, 30),
        schedule_next_run=next_run,
    )


def _scheduled_organizer_export(organizer, user, next_run):
    return ScheduledOrganizerExport.objects.create(
        organizer=organizer,
        owner=user,
        export_identifier='orderlist',
        export_form_data={},
        locale='en',
        mail_subject='Export',
        mail_template='Here is your export.',
        schedule_rrule='FREQ=DAILY',
        schedule_rrule_time=time(6, 30),
        schedule_next_run=next_run,
        timezone='UTC',
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
@freeze_time("2023-01-19 12:00:00")
def test_run_scheduled_exports_queues_due_event_export(event, user):
    s = _scheduled_event_export(event, user, now() - timedelta(minutes=1))

    with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async') as apply_async:
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)

    apply_async.assert_called_once_with(kwargs={'event': event.pk, 'schedule': s.pk})
    s.refresh_from_db()
    assert s.schedule_next_run > now()


@pytest.mark.django_db
@freeze_time("2023-01-19 12:00:00")
def test_run_scheduled_exports_queues_due_organizer_export(event, user):
    organizer = event.organizer
    s = _scheduled_organizer_export(organizer, user, now() - timedelta(minutes=1))

    with mock.patch.object(scheduled_organizer_export, 'apply_async') as apply_async:
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)

    apply_async.assert_called_once_with(kwargs={'organizer': organizer.pk, 'schedule': s.pk})
    s.refresh_from_db()
    assert s.schedule_next_run > now()


@pytest.mark.django_db
@freeze_time("2023-01-19 12:00:00")
def test_run_scheduled_exports_skips_schedules_not_yet_due(event, user):
    _scheduled_event_export(event, user, now() + timedelta(minutes=1))
    _scheduled_organizer_export(event.organizer, user, now() + timedelta(minutes=1))

    with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async') as event_apply_async, \
            mock.patch.object(scheduled_organizer_export, 'apply_async') as organizer_apply_async:
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)

    event_apply_async.assert_not_called()
    organizer_apply_async.assert_not_called()


@pytest.mark.django_db
@freeze_time("2023-01-19 12:00:00")
def test_run_scheduled_exports_skips_schedules_without_next_run(event, user):
    _scheduled_event_export(event, user, None)
    _scheduled_organizer_export(event.organizer, user, None)

    with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async') as event_apply_async, \
            mock.patch.object(scheduled_organizer_export, 'apply_async') as organizer_apply_async:
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)

    event_apply_async.assert_not_called()
    organizer_apply_async.assert_not_called()


@pytest.mark.django_db
@freeze_time("2023-01-19 12:00:00")
def test_run_scheduled_exports_does_not_queue_same_run_twice(event, user):
    _scheduled_event_export(event, user, now() - timedelta(minutes=1))

    with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async') as apply_async:
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)

    assert apply_async.call_count == 1
EOF
